e.title: Longevity & Mortality Investor
e.summary: 长寿/死亡率市场资讯（L&M Investor）：养老金风险转移、买断交易的市场新闻源
e.body: Longevity & Mortality Investor（lminvestor.com）是长寿与死亡率市场的专业资讯源：养老金风险转移（PRT）买断交易、长寿互换、再保险交易的市场新闻与数据。对 RIAA：长寿/养老金市场的一手资讯——[[longevity-risk]]（长寿风险）的市场实践侧（谁在买断养老金、定价走向）；与 [[human-mortality-db]]（学术数据）互补：市场交易数据 + 学术死亡率数据；养老金融求职/研究的行业动态入口；配合 [[claude-finance-agents]]（退休规划 AI）理解养老金市场的供需两端。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：官网确认（养老金风险转移/长寿互换市场新闻），未实测订阅
e.summary_en: Longevity/mortality market news (L&M Investor): pension risk-transfer buyout deals and market data
e.summary_hk: 長壽/死亡率市場資訊（L&M Investor）：養老金風險轉移、買斷交易的市場新聞源
e.body_en: Longevity & Mortality Investor (lminvestor.com) is a specialist news source on the longevity and mortality market: pension risk transfer (PRT) buyout deals, longevity swaps and reinsurance transactions, with market news and data. For RIAA: first-hand news on the longevity/pension market — the market-practice side of [[longevity-risk]] (who buys out pensions, pricing trends); complementary to [[human-mortality-db]] (academic data): market transaction data + academic mortality data; an industry-dynamics entry for pension-finance job hunting and research; with [[claude-finance-agents]] (retirement-planning AI) it shows both supply and demand sides of the pension market.
e.body_hk: Longevity & Mortality Investor（lminvestor.com）是長壽與死亡率市場的專業資訊源：養老金風險轉移（PRT）買斷交易、長壽互換、再保險交易的市場新聞與數據。對 RIAA：長壽/養老金市場的一手資訊——[[longevity-risk]]（長壽風險）的市場實踐側（誰在買斷養老金、定價走向）；與 [[human-mortality-db]]（學術數據）互補：市場交易數據 + 學術死亡率數據；養老金融求職/研究的行業動態入口；配合 [[claude-finance-agents]]（退休規劃 AI）理解養老金市場的供需兩端。
